howto: Tap a golden pin to pull it: whatever sits in that glass chamber drops down its pipe.
Get the key into the green lock chamber to finish the level.
Lava melts the key and burns gems; water poured onto lava turns it into harmless stone. A red PIT swallows anything that falls in.
Gems already in the lock when the key arrives are your stars. 8 levels, each unlocked by the one before.
tips: The level ends the moment the key lands, so send the gems down first.
A chamber with two pins empties through whichever pin you pulled first, forever after.
Pour water before the key, never after.
Hint tries every remaining pull order and glows the pin that keeps the most gems safe.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys pick a pin (white box), Space or Enter pulls it, Z undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a golden pin to pull it. Undo and Hint sit under the chambers. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Levels ramp from one pin to six pins with pits, two-way chambers and two lava pools; each level unlocks the next. The Hint button is the assist.

cheats.effect: The best next pin always glows

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): the game solves the level from where you are and glows the next pin to pull
features.undo: Undo takes back the last pull, even after the key melts
features.level-select-or-daily: 8-level select on the title screen with stars; levels unlock in order
features.results: UNLOCKED! card with stars and gems saved; THE KEY MELTED! card with Undo
